papers.title: Dual drug spatiotemporal release from functional gradient scaffolds prepared using 3<scp>D</scp> bioprinting and electrospinning
papers.abstract: Functional gradient scaffolds play an important role in osteochondral tissue engineering because they can meet the essential requirement for a gradual transition of both physical and chemical properties in osteochondral tissue regeneration. There is a requirement for 3D composite osteochondral regeneration scaffolds with multiscale structures that are capable of controlling release of multiple biomolecules. To this end, this article describes a 3D bioprinting platform integrated forming system designed to produce various drug‐loaded scaffolds. A novel scaffold was fabricated by the self‐developed 3D bioprinting platform combining extrusion deposition with multi‐nozzle electrospinning. For temporally controlled release of gentamycin sulfate (GS) and desferoxamine (DFO), blend electrospun GS/polyvinyl alcohol (PVA) and coaxial electrospun core (PVA‐DFO)/shell (polycaprolactone; PCL) fibers were deposited in the scaffold. After a 25‐day time‐lapse release study in vitro, results showed GS released faster than DFO during the early stages and sustained release of DFO for long periods. For spatially controlled release of DFO, the vertically gradient gelatin/sodium alginate (SA) scaffolds presented to enable the release amount of DFO in a gradient mode. The experiment and test results demonstrate the validity of the 3D bioprinting platform integrated forming system and the excellent properties of such scaffolds for performing multidrug spatiotemporal release. POLYM. ENG. SCI., 56:170–177, 2016. © 2015 Society of Plastics Engineers

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及3D生物打印支架的制造和药物释放，但完全没有使用AI或机器学习方法，与AI生物打印方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on scaffold fabrication and drug release without any AI or machine learning integration into the bioprinting workflow.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发具有多尺度结构和多药时空释放功能的骨软骨再生支架。
summary_zh.method: 采用集成挤出沉积和多喷嘴静电纺丝的3D生物打印平台制备梯度支架。
summary_zh.result: 实现了庆大霉素和去铁胺的时空控制释放，早期快速释放GS，长期持续释放DFO。
summary_zh.validation: 通过25天体外释放实验验证药物释放行为。

summary_en.motivation: To fabricate functional gradient scaffolds with controlled spatiotemporal release of multiple drugs for osteochondral tissue regeneration.
summary_en.method: A 3D bioprinting platform combining extrusion deposition and multi-nozzle electrospinning was used to produce drug-loaded scaffolds with gradient structures.
summary_en.result: The scaffold enabled temporally controlled release of gentamycin sulfate and desferoxamine, with rapid early release of GS and sustained release of DFO over 25 days.
summary_en.validation: In vitro drug release studies over 25 days demonstrated the controlled release profiles.
